meta.description: RINRO is an indie app studio crafting simple software that quietly improves everyday life.

home.aboutBody: RINRO is an indie app studio creating software that quietly removes small frictions from daily life. We focus on what is essential, reduce unnecessary complexity, and care for experiences that remain pleasant over time.
home.appsBody: A showcase for current and upcoming RINRO applications. Product details will be added as each app becomes ready.
home.hinotoDescription: A new daily management app for working people, supporting morning planning, midday focus, and evening wrap-up in one flow, with daily reports, reflection, and time analysis.
home.yosugaDescription: An application that turns saving into a promise with your future self, then returns it in a form you can keep.
home.newsBody: Release announcements, product updates, media coverage, and notes from RINRO.
home.contactBody: For inquiries, please reach us by email or through X.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.accessLogsBody: This website may record server logs such as IP address, browser information, and access time for stable operation and security. These logs are not used to identify individuals.
privacy.cookiesBody: This website stores your language preference in the browser's localStorage. The analytics we use does not rely on cookies.
privacy.emailsBody: Email addresses and message contents received through inquiries are used only for replies and necessary support.
privacy.analyticsBody: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics as a privacy-conscious analytics tool. It does not use cookies, does not collect personally identifiable information, and does not track behaviour across other websites. Only aggregate statistics such as page views and referrers are used to improve the site.

article.templateBody: This page is a reusable news article template. Duplicate it when creating release announcements, media coverage, or featured articles.
article.launchBody: The official RINRO website has launched. Future release announcements, major updates, media coverage, and featured articles will be shared here.

article.pressnowTitle: Hinoto press release featured on PRESSNOW
article.pressnowDescription: The press release for the iOS app Hinoto has been featured on PRESSNOW.
article.pressnowBody1Prefix: A press release for Hinoto, the iOS app from RINRO, has been featured on the press release site
article.pressnowBody2: Hinoto is a daily management app that supports morning planning, midday focus, and evening reflection in one continuous flow. We will continue improving the app so working people can better engage with their time and spend each day more comfortably.
article.yosugaLaunchTitle: Yosuga is now available on the App Store
article.yosugaLaunchBody1: Yosuga, the iOS app that turns saving into a promise to your future self, is now available on the App Store. Entrust something you care about, and a quiet word arrives on the promised day so you can see it through — reading, watching, going, buying, or making. The promise loop (entrust → word → today's promises → fulfill) is free to use.
article.yosugaLaunchBody2: See the product page for the full details. We'll keep refining the app so it can hand your promises to your future self, quietly and surely.
